description: PC2 (bean qou-6ngr): tests whether anti-parallel-pair collision data satisfies the uniform-c' discrete Riccati lower bound (hypothesis of the Lean lemma riccati_lower_growth) in the corpus two-regime ODE model. SHARP PHASE-WISE FINDING: in the separated (Biot-Savart) phase the bound HOLDS with c' EXACTLY uniform — d^2*Omega is an exact invariant of the phase-1 flow ((d^2)' = -Gamma/pi, Omega' = Gamma*Omega/(pi*d^2)), giving c' = Gamma/(pi*d0^2*Omega0) = 1/pi here — the branch-A Riccati mechanism is LIVE during the approach. It is destroyed precisely at overlap onset (hyperbolic-overlap saturation caps the strain), which engages at t_overlap ~ 3.1348, only ~0.2% before the inviscid singular time t* = pi: the saturation is the regularizing cutoff, engaging just before blow-up. The pair-channel question thus sharpens to: does the overlap regime ALWAYS engage before d -> 0 (regular, branch B), or can data delay V1 growth past t* (blow-up, branch A)? Scope (a) throughout. Consistent with the lock-scaling probe and the sustained-forcing picture. Exploratory tier, float64 Euler.
